name: BEA 'Red Square' retro (BA100)
description: Fuselage: White upper fuselage, light gray lower fuselage and belly. Cheatlines: A black band through the window line from the black nose anti-glare panel to the tail. Tail: White fin with a red square containing 'BEA' in white capitals; registration in black at the fin tip. Engines: Gray/silver. Winglets: Red wingtip fences. Titles: Small red 'BEA' squares on the forward and rear fuselage at window level; Union flag by the cockpit; 'British Airways' with Speedmarque and BA100 '1919-2019' logo on the aft fuselage. Artwork: none. Colors hex: approximate.
notes: The only BA100 retro still flying.
